# cgltf

Vendored from https://github.com/jkuhlmann/cgltf at commit
`85cd62382dfea638278962690cf515023f33ed00`.

`cgltf.h` is unmodified. The implementation is compiled privately into
Ldx12Utils by `GltfLoader.cpp`; consumers do not need cgltf headers.
cgltf is distributed under the MIT License; the complete upstream text is
preserved in `LICENSE`. The embedded JSMN parser is also distributed under the
MIT License, with its own copyright and complete license text preserved inside
`cgltf.h`.
